supersedes.reason: Canonical definitions and ontology state must precede the current CLI baseline; @1 remains immutable historical evidence.

derived_current_views.rule: These derived current-state views must bind this completed manifest and digest exactly; they do not author baseline membership.

instantiation_contract.selection_rule: Use exactly one realization row matching the requested backend meta-type id and language.
instantiation_contract.generated_receipt_binding: Every output receipt must bind baseline_id, baseline_digest, selected row paths and selected row digests.
instantiation_contract.mutation_policy: A changed frozen byte requires a new baseline id and manifest; this manifest is never regenerated in place.
